name: merge_up
declaration: unsafe fn merge_up < F : FnMut (& T , & T) -> bool > (& mut self , mut right : * const T , right_end : * const T , is_less : & mut F ,)
documentation:
# Safety
 The caller MUST guarantee that `self` is initialized in a way where `start -> end` is
 the longer sub-slice and so that `dst` can be written to at least the shorter sub-slice
 length times. In addition `start -> end` and `right -> right_end` MUST be valid to be
 read. This function MUST only be called once.
rules: The caller must ensure that `self` is initialized so that `start -> end` is the longer sub-slice.
The caller must ensure that `self.dst` can be written to at least as many times as the shorter sub-slice's length.
The caller must ensure that `self.start -> self.end` is valid to be read.
The caller must ensure that `right -> right_end` is valid to be read.
